glosses: to put, to position, to place, to set, to align, to array (to place a person or thing somewhere so that it stands there)
to set up (to assemble something makeshift)
to adjust, to set, to set up (to select a mode of a device's operation by adjusting it)
to set up (to influence the course or outcome of something or someone's behavior)
to set someone up for success (to manage someone's affairs in a favorable way)
to determine the nature of the role played by an actor or its elements
to line up, to queue up, to form up, to fall in (to stand somewhere in a certain way)
to get one's foot in the door, to set oneself up for success (to manage one's affairs in a favorable way)

examples.text: Po chwili na milicyjnej twarzy pojawił się znaczący uśmiech, a zaraz potem dłoń powędrowała w górę i ustawiła na blacie pełną butelkę grodziskiego
